TEXT: [FI] It's great that the school trip went off without a hitch, but...
[FI] The next question is, just how am I going to give Ayase her souvenir?
[FI] Just calling her out would be the easiest way...
[FI] Would she really come if I did?
[FI] In fact, Ayase was blocking my phone number until just recently.
[FI] She finally decided to unblock me after I listened to her troubles on various occasions.
[FI] But, wait...
[FI] If she unblocked me...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Onii-san, please give me a call, okay?
[FI] That has to be it!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Alright, you just wait, Ayase-tan!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Yes, Aragaki speaking.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, Ayase? It's me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] She hung up?!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Yes?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Don't just hang up on me like that!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Did you need something?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Of course!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...I see. Actually, there's something I wanted to talk to you about, Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh? Great timing then.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Yes.
[FI] Ayase didn't sound too enthusiastic.
[FI] Could she be worrying about something again?
[FI] Or could it be...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] A-Are you having some kind of weird fantasies now?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Just for the record, it's not like I'm going to confess to you or anything, Onii-san.
[FI] ...She's telling me off before I've even opened my mouth.
[FI] Well, this time I'm just naturally concerned about Ayase, but...
[FI] Regardless of how many events we've had, she's the kind of heroine whose affection level just won't rise.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...W-Why aren't you saying anything?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Sorry. Hmm, I'm not really sure where to begin...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Then it's probably nothing important, is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ayase, do you... hate me?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Eh...? O-Of course I do.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Don't you remember... what you've done to me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...That's right.
[FI] Ayase definitely hated me.
[FI] However, we've been talking more recently, so I forgot about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, let me hear you out at least.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I've bought you those oil absorbing sheets you asked for in your mail.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, really? Thank you very much!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Don't mention it.
[FI] Great. Seems like Ayase liked it.
[FI] I knew it'd be worth my while to get those.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's all I wanted to say. What did you want to talk about?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Yes, about that...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Um... I... have something that I need to discuss with you, Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I see. Leave it to me! You can tell me anything.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Eh? ...Are you sure? You've already agreed... before I even tell you what it is.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You might hate me, but I sure love you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Eh?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'll listen to your troubles any time you want.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] N-Now you're just saying nice things again...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Y-You're planning something bad again, aren't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I don't know if it's bad or not, but I am planning something.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I-I knew it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] My plan is that by listening to your troubles, I hope I can raise your impression of me at least a little bit.
[FI] ...Hm, that settles it.
[FI] This girl should be completely smitten with me now.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...H-Hmph, you're saying such embarrassing things again...
[FI] Huh? That's weird.
[FI] Well, guess she isn't that naive.
[FI] I wouldn't be troubled over this if such superficial words would improve Ayase's view of me.
[FI] ...It wasn't a lie though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Anyway, I'll hear you out.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Yes...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Actually, I feel like Kirino's been rather cold towards me lately...
[FI] That's what I thought.
[FI] Ayase's concerns always revolve around Kirino.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Alright. Anyway, I want to give you your souvenir from Kyoto, so want to meet up somewhere?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] T-Then... at the usual park.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That place, huh...
[FI] Whenever Ayase has something to talk about, she calls me to the nearby park.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...There's a police box right on the other side of that park, so it's useless to try and do something to me there, Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hahaha, I wouldn't.
[FI] ...She sure doesn't trust me, huh.
